title: Week of July 13–19
subtitle: Week 5 · Block 2 begins — new main lifts (Front Squat / Incline Bench / Paused Deadlift / Push Press) and the mileage build to 20: 14 → 17 → 20 this block.
goals: Calibrate the four new mains: ramp to a top set at ~2 RIR, log it — weeks 2–3 build from what you hit this week.
Mileage ~14 mi this week (17 next, 20 the week after) — Tuesday is the one hard run, everything else strict Z2.
Back care: it cracked on 7/6 from dropping fast into the hole — slow eccentrics on front squat, pause deadlift capped at 205 if it talks at all.
Protein ≥180g, eat to the SMART goal — 195.3 → 189.9 by Aug 14, you're ahead of pace.
review: Deload week did its job, with one caveat. Monday's squat back-crack came from dropping too fast into the hole on a weight that felt light — your own journal nailed the fix: slow the eccentric when the bar feels easy. It lingered through Thursday but you were 'Good' by Friday and pulled 235 cleanly, and pull-ups felt noticeably stronger — that's the deload paying out. Run discipline was the best it's been: Thursday's 2 mi at 140 avg HR is exactly the Z2 easy-run this rebuild has been missing, and Tuesday's trimmed quality run (3.0 @ 164) was right on script. ~11.5 mi total. Now the new block, built from your two calls tonight: (1) mains rotate — Front Squat (you already found it clicks), Incline Barbell Bench, Paused Deadlift, and Push Press (programmed on purpose this time — strict OHP retests in Block 3); (2) the run ramp goes 14 → 17 → 20, so you cross 20 mi the week of July 27 and stay above it from Block 3 on. This addresses your 'progression is too slow' note while keeping the deload rhythm that just proved its worth. Week 1 of new lifts = calibration: ramp to ~2 RIR tops, log honestly, and weeks 2–3 will push. The whole roadmap (Blocks 2–4, lift rotations, mileage) is in TRAINING_CYCLE.md in the repo. Weight 195.3 and ahead of pace for Aug 14. HRV/sleep still isn't syncing from Apple Health — worth a look sometime this week.
